standard_prerequisites: Littelmann string/crystal and pre-canonical Hecke inputs as printed
core_obligations: Given the authors cited geometric hyperbolic-localization/recharge wall-crossing formalism, adapted-string parametrization and pre-canonical Hecke-basis inputs, the new type-C2 proof must handle the failure of the type-A within-atom swapping rule. It constructs compatible symmetric atomic decompositions, classifies swappable versus non-swappable twisted-Bruhat edges in all root directions, computes cumulative edge defects and maximal non-swappable staircases with parity/boundary cases, and uses the staircase elevation to send elements between different atoms while preserving the required recharge jump. These constructions identify the parabolic starting statistic and prove that the explicit r_m values evolve by the actual swapping functions across every chamber wall. This is one nonroutine H3 wall-crossing/combinatorial construction beyond applying the cited geometric principle or checking a single crystal-operator identity. The ten legacy helpers, atomic decomposition and equivalent charge interpretations support this complete primary framework and receive no additional independent IDs.
